executive_summary.headline: Three user-supplied Amazon links resolve to three verified air-fryer product pages. Prices, ratings, commission rates and trend data are not published, because they could not be verified or the Associates policy does not allow them on this site.
bullets: Identity verified: each link resolves to an Amazon product page (ASINs B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH). All three sit under the same Amazon category path (Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers). Brands: Chefman (P1, P3) and Emeril (P2, from its Item details table). Flag F-04 covers the short-link codes.

Pricing and ratings withheld: the Associates Participation Requirements (Section 2(b) and Section 3(t)) allow prices and star ratings on a site only through Amazon-served links or Creators API / PA API. The pages were read, but no price, rating or review count is published (F-02).
Commission potential not calculable: the category commission schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in, so no rate is entered (F-01). Third-party sources conflict on the Kitchen rate.
Attribution unverified: the resolved links contain no Associates tag parameter (F-03). Confirm the links are generated under your Associates ID before relying on any earnings.

Compliance: the required disclosure sentence appears on every page (R-01). Open legal items: the Conditions of Use limit collecting listing content, data mining and using Amazon content for AI models (F-11, F-12). Participation Requirements Section 5 and IP License Section 1 also bar machine-learning use of Amazon data without express written approval (F-17). The AI content automation is therefore NOT built.

Not built: automated product research, PA-API integration, click and conversion tracking, AI article generation and campaign optimisation. Each needs PA-API or Associates reporting access, a rate source, or a compliance decision first.
Site: GitHub Pages entry point redirects from the repository root to the static site in docs/. Every table row links to an official source, and unverified values are blank and flagged.
Automation: research, AI articles, publishing and click or conversion tracking need PA-API / Creators API access and Associates eligibility, which this site does not have (F-22).
decisions_needed: Confirm amazon.com is the intended storefront and whether the links were generated under your Associates ID (F-03, F-09).
Read the category commission rate from Associates Central and send it for entry (F-01).
Choose whether to apply for PA-API / Creators API access so prices and ratings can be shown (F-02, F-16).
Decide whether any AI work may use Amazon-derived data. This needs express written approval from Associates (F-17, F-18, F-19).

analysis.finding: All three products are in one niche: countertop air fryers and air-fry toaster ovens.
analysis.basis: Breadcrumb on all three product pages: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers.

analysis.finding: Two of the three products share a brand (Chefman). P2's brand is Emeril.
analysis.basis: Brand on P1 and P3 reads Chefman (title and byline). P2's Item details table lists Brand Name 'Emeril' and Manufacturer 'Emeril Lagasse' (F-05, resolved).
analysis.confidence: Verified (P2 from Item details; P1 and P3 from title and byline)

analysis.finding: The set spans three formats: a 6-litre dual-basket oven (P1), an 8-quart single-basket air fryer (P3) and a 24.6-litre French-door toaster oven (P2).
analysis.basis: Capacity fields as listed. The units differ across title and specification (F-06), so values are shown as listed, not compared numerically.

analysis.finding: Amazon's own 'also viewed' lists show competing air fryers from at least six other brands. P1 and P3 each list another Chefman model.
analysis.basis: Also-viewed carousel, first three items per product, re-confirmed 2026-11-14: P1 (Chefman, Gourmia, Nutrichef), P2 (Emeril, Ninja, HotKing), P3 (Chefman, Chefman, Cosori). The 'Sponsored' label is inconsistent across snapshots, so these lists may include paid placements (F-10).
analysis.confidence: Verified as shown; sponsored status unclear (F-10)

analysis.finding: Commission potential cannot be estimated on this site.
analysis.basis: Commission is paid on Qualifying Revenue (Commission Income Statement, Section 1; summarised in the earlier pass and not re-read in full this session). The category rate is unverified (F-01), and prices may not be published (F-02). No earnings figure is given.

analysis.finding: Trend and conversion performance cannot be measured from verified sources.
analysis.basis: No official trend or conversion data was available. Amazon's on-page popularity badges are not reproduced (F-15).

analysis.finding: Attribution to the user's Associates account is not confirmed.
analysis.basis: The resolved product URLs carry no 'tag=' parameter (F-03).
